author: DiegoCastillo

title: Horse drawn carriage tour !
text: Our horse-drawn carriage tour around Seville’s historic sights was a truly memorable experience! Despite some concerns about horse treatment, we found all the horses we saw to be well-groomed, healthy, and clearly cared for, which put our minds at ease. The 40-minute tour, costing 45 Euros, took us through the beautiful landmarks of Seville in a unique and charming way. The mild October weather was perfect—not only comfortable for us but also seemed ideal for the horses. This is a fantastic way to experience the city’s history, and we’d definitely recommend it!
author: Roam813681

title: A Nice, Open-Air Way Get a Seville Overview
text: This horse-and-buggy tour was a great, slow-paced way to get an overview of the central part of Seville. This is especially true because the ride did go through the very large Maria Luisa Park, and that would have been a very long walk. The ride did also go along the river and my a good many key landmarks and government buildings.

title: an amazing Sunday morning horse ride
